project_name: Vikas Subramani - Interactive Web Specialist & Lead Developer
archetype: Editorial Future (Wide Display Sans + Geometric Body, high-end editorial light portfolio with bold typography and colorful interactions)
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning, highly interactive editorial light portfolio for Vikas Subramani, Lead Web Developer at Parul University Goa.
Include a custom smooth cursor effect, scroll reveals, rich kinetic typography, and vibrant interactive highlights.
Implement top navigation bar with glassmorphic style (solid/semi-solid background, NEVER fully transparent), branding, smooth anchor navigation, and quick contact action.
Hero section: Bold editorial statement, live availability status badge, interactive contact CTA buttons (Email, Phone +91 6362366890, WhatsApp), and professional portrait / workspace showcase.
Services & Team Capabilities section: Bento grid highlighting Fully Custom & Animated Interfaces, End-to-End Functionality, Cloud Infrastructure & GCP, and Unbeatable Cost-Efficiency.

Hackathon & Case Studies section: Interactive case study cards featuring Hackathon Project #1 (interactive web application with real-time API processing) and Hackathon Project #2 (multi-page cloud portal with GCP deployment).
Skills & Core Expertise section: Interactive filterable tags and categorized skill matrix (Frontend/Animations, Backend/Cloud, Design & Optimization).
Education & Certifications section: Parul University Goa Campus (Expected 2028), Google Cloud Platform Training & Skill Badges.
Client Pitch / Outreach Template viewer: Interactive copy-to-clipboard widget displaying Vikas's professional client pitch.
Interactive Project Inquiry Form: Fully functional form with validation, Shadcn UI inputs, and Sonner toast notification on success.
Footer: Dramatic editorial layout with direct contact info, social links, and quick navigation.
Ensure all interactive elements and buttons include `data-testid` attributes for robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You must build using .js/.jsx files (React JS with Tailwind CSS).
Never use fully transparent header backgrounds; use glassmorphism or solid backgrounds.
Every interactive element must include data-testid attributes.
Avoid generic centered layouts; use editorial asymmetry and generous spacing (p-8, p-12, etc.).
